_comment: Copy to aimpsim_config.json only to override the model shipped in AIMPSim/llm/. {"llm": "off"} reads requests by rules alone; {"llm": {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8089"}} uses a llama-server already running. max_rounds: the safety limit on the rounds of a design, optimisation or calibration that runs until it answers (they end on their own criteria; 0 = no limit).
